title: Full Nextflow/Snakemake DAG: all samples x all callers to normalised to scored to aggregated
context: M2 full benchmark harness for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Implements the reproducible Nextflow/Snakemake DAG running all simulated samples through all callers, normalising, scoring, and aggregating with complete per-cell provenance. One-command reproducibility and a maintainer-verified re-run are the integrity guarantees; resource usage is captured per caller. No patient data is touched.
objective: Build the full workflow DAG (all samples x all callers -> FusionCall -> scored -> aggregated) that runs reproducibly via one command with complete provenance and resource capture.
acceptanceCriteria: Full simulated benchmark runs reproducibly via one command; provenance complete for every cell; maintainer re-run matches.
Resource usage (runtime, peak memory) captured per caller per sample.
output: A pull request adding the full Nextflow/Snakemake workflow (workflow/) producing aggregated, provenance-bound scored results.
